changes: 6 of the 800 test documents. Word boxes re-laid-out into lines; no other edits. CORD's annotation covers only the item and total area, so these texts have no store header, address or date. Note on cord-test-13: the reader's "total" is the pre-tax TOTAL line (46.636); the dataset's total_price label points at the GRAND TOTAL line, which the reader proposes as grand_total (51.300). Both are in the text; gold checks both. cord-test-38/41/70/85 were added in a later stress pass: harder receipts (9-11 items, category subtotal rows, wrapped labels, label-only and amount-before-label totals, OCR noise). Their gold checks the totals and the items the text actually shows; wrapped items printed on split lines stay for a person or Jev to check. synthetic-swiss-1 is fully synthetic: a made-up Swiss hotel receipt (German labels, CHF codes, à unit prices, OCR edge junk) added as a regression case for European receipts; it is not a real document.
